slices.description: The research-only route receipt boundary derives the active route from the command occurrence, validates the exact ordered lane journals and opaque VerifiedLaneCompositionV1 witnesses against governed coordinator releases, selects the route release guest image, and verifies an explicit nonempty SUCCINCT receipt over canonical RouteCompositionJournalV1 bytes. It emits opaque VerifiedRouteCompositionV1 evidence for later bounded epoch recursion and carries no commit or publication capability.

evidence.claim: The Python functional core derives the governed route, enforces exact lane count and order, binds each opaque verified-lane witness to its journal and coordinator image, and constructs route authority only after exact receipt verification.
The Rust ABI reference implements the parallel verifier-owned opaque witness and the same profile, route, lane, journal, image, receipt-kind, and resource bindings.

Python and Rust regressions accept one exact governed route receipt, share the same route journal digest and binding root, and reject structural, missing, duplicated, substituted, epoch-neighbor, empty, wrong-kind, and verifier-rejected inputs.
Route release identity now commits the composer guest image plus specification, source, and toolchain roots in Python and Rust golden parity.

guards.formula: profile.status = ACTIVE and route = profile.route_registry[occurrence.command_kind] and route.release_id = claimed_route_release_id
guards.meaning: The caller cannot select a foreign, inactive, or command-incompatible route.

guards.formula: len(lane_journals) = len(verified_lanes) = len(route.ordered_lanes) and lane_journals[i].lane_id = route.ordered_lanes[i]
guards.meaning: Missing, extra, duplicated, and reordered lane inputs cannot change the governed proof shape.

guards.formula: verified_lanes[i] binds profile, route, lane, coordinator_release, occurrence, writer_epoch, journal_root, journal_digest, coordinator_image, and SUCCINCT kind of lane_journals[i]
guards.meaning: Proof authority from one lane journal cannot be transferred to another structural journal.

guards.formula: receipt.kind = SUCCINCT and len(receipt.bytes) > 0 and verifier.verify(route.guest_image_id, canonical(route_journal), receipt.bytes) = accepted
guards.meaning: The release-selected route statement and the verified public bytes are identical.
